answer: Each identity sows one meadow per key and tends it solo; every vote grows 12 POA of share there, vesting only after audit. Each epoch the roll posts a fresh cipher keyed to that meadow; its owner decrypts and returns it within 60 seconds. Lottery graders dive one meadow in eight, re-decrypting each cipher. A missed, stale, or shared answer sinks the unvested share to the reef, the audit fund, and benches the key two epochs. N fakes × 12 POA = 12N POA forfeited per epoch. Limit: honest shares vest on the same clock.
